description:
You are a demand planning manager. Using the sales data provided, you need to create a forecast report.

Data Source: 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\sales_data.csv'

Your Goal: Create and save a Power BI report named 'Monthly_Trend_Forecast.pbix' on the Desktop that contains:

1. A DAX measure named exactly 'Running_Total' that calculates the cumulative sum of 'Sales_Amount' over time (using the Sale_Date column).
2. A Line Chart showing 'Sales_Amount' by 'Sale_Date' (Month granularity). On this visual, you must enable a Trend Line AND a Forecast from the Analytics pane.
3. An Area Chart showing your 'Running_Total' measure by 'Sale_Date' (Month granularity) to visualize cumulative growth.

Save the final report to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\Monthly_Trend_Forecast.pbix'.
